candidates.name: role_tool_pruned
candidates.hypothesis: Constrain SWE-bench topology nodes to a small set of valid repository and memory tools instead of the full registry; this should reduce wasted tool turns and prevent stale tool-filter mismatches from starving verifier and formatter roles of the intended read-only context.
candidates.changes_from_baseline: Monkey-patches sage.agent_loop_factory.create_node_agent_loop so planner/coder/verifier/synth roles receive a tight, valid tool subset (execute_bash plus read-only memory tools) instead of the full registry or stale nonexistent tool names.
